patch_description:
This crossover ansatz keeps the efficient shared-parameter structure of the stronger low-parameter program, while borrowing the more global entangling style from the deeper reference circuit.

Key changes inside the EVOLVE-BLOCK:
- Uses only 6 trainable parameters per block, so the circuit stays parameter-efficient.
- Replaces the purely local CZ/CNOT pattern with a cross-half CZ layer plus a shifted-ring CNOT layer to improve long-range mixing.
- Keeps a final non-diagonal RY layer so the block still feeds useful amplitude changes into the next re-uploading stage and the final Z readout.
- Mixes parity-based and half-split parameter sharing to reduce overfitting while preserving expressivity.

The rest of the program is unchanged, so inputs/outputs and the training loop remain identical.
